front.title: Agent Gateway Interconnection: Use Cases and Requirements

abstract.t: This document defines use cases and requirements for interconnection of Agent Gateways (AGWs) across separate administrative domains. An Agent Gateway acts as a trust and protocol boundary for AI agents, mediating agent discovery, intent routing, policy enforcement, context translation, and secure cross-domain collaboration. This draft does not specify a wire protocol. Instead, it collects representative deployment scenarios and derives functional, operational, and interoperability requirements to guide future protocol design for AGW-to-AGW interconnection.
